effects: The vault pulls exactly `assets` USDC from the signer with transferFrom, which spends the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
The vault mints smUSDC shares to `receiver`. The number is floor(assets × (totalSupply + 10^12) / (lastTotalAssets + 1)) after interest accrues.
Before the deposit, the vault mints performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This sets the share price the signer gets.
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue markets in supply-queue order. The signer's position is the shares only.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", then the USDC amount (tokenAmount with the USDC constant), a constant 'Share ticker: smUSDC', and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many smUSDC shares the receiver gets; the vault derives this from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The descriptor only shows 'Share ticker' as the raw constant `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker`, with no amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix is possible: the share count is not in the calldata, and ERC-4626 deposit has no minimum-shares parameter.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" names neither the asset nor the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, with no interpolatedIntent. The code takes USDC (`SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`) and mints smUSDC.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit USDC into smUSDC vault" and add the interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for smUSDC shares to {receiver}".

effects: The vault pulls USDC from the signer. The amount is ceil(shares × (lastTotalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 10^12)), computed after interest accrues, and it spends the signer's USDC allowance.
The vault mints exactly `shares` smUSDC to `receiver`.
Before the mint, the vault mints performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This sets the price the signer pays.
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", 'Deposit asset: USDC' as a raw constant, the minted share amount (tokenAmount of the vault token), and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show the USDC amount taken from the signer. The amount comes from the share price in storage, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. The descriptor shows only `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: No field can show the amount. Change the 'Deposit asset' label to 'Pays with (amount set by share price)' so the signer knows the USDC amount is variable.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays USDC to get vault shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`, with no interpolatedIntent. The code pulls USDC from the caller in ERC4626._deposit with `safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint smUSDC shares" and add the interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver}".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns smUSDC shares from `owner`. The amount is ceil(assets × (totalSupply + 10^12) / (lastTotalAssets + 1)), computed after interest accrues.
If the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends `owner`'s share allowance to the signer by that share amount.
The vault withdraws liquidity from Morpho markets and sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver`.
Before the withdrawal, the vault mints performance-fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", 'Withdraw exactly' with the USDC amount, the receiver as 'To', and the share owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many smUSDC shares are burned from the owner; the vault derives this from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares);`. The descriptor has no shares field.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix is possible: the share count is not in the calldata.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" names neither the asset nor that vault shares are burned.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`, with no interpolatedIntent. ERC4626._withdraw runs `_burn(owner, shares); SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);`.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Withdraw USDC from smUSDC vault" and add the interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` smUSDC from `owner`.
If the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends `owner`'s share allowance to the signer by `shares`.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount is floor(shares × (lastTotalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 10^12)), computed after interest accrues, with no minimum.
Before the redemption, the vault mints performance-fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", 'Shares to redeem' (tokenAmount of the vault token), the receiver as 'To', and the share owner.

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount the receiver gets, and nothing sets a minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The descriptor has no field for the asset that arrives.
findings.fix: No field can show the amount. You can add a constant field 'Receive: USDC' (`$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`) so the signer at least sees the output asset.

findings.title: redeem intent and fields never say that the signer receives USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: `"intent": "Redeem"` with the fields shares, receiver and owner only. ERC4626._withdraw runs `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets)`, where _asset is USDC.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Redeem smUSDC shares for USDC" and add the interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

findings.title: metadata.owner is "Gauntlet", but the vault's on-chain name is "Seamless Flagship USDC Vault".
findings.evidence: meta.json constructorArguments: `__name: "Seamless Flagship USDC Vault"`, `__symbol: "smUSDC"`. descriptor metadata: `"owner": "Gauntlet"`. Gauntlet may be the curator, but the source does not show it.
findings.fix: Confirm the curator. Consider an owner such as "Seamless (curated by Gauntlet)".
